name: Kaunas

routes.outcome: Official Lithuanian geoportal identifies Nekilnojamojo turto kadastro žemėlapis (sklypų duomenys), the national real-estate cadastral map with parcel data.
Official Kaunas municipal map page; public JavaScript map interface is documented for Kaunas.
Official Kaunas ArcGIS service metadata lists Sklypai, a polygon layer covering Kaunas municipality; provider is VĮ Registrų centras, service owner UAB Kauno planas, CRS LKS-94 / EPSG:3346.
Parcel layer schema inspected. Safe native fields include unikalus_nr, OBJECTID, and GlobalID; other cadastral/use/status fields were not requested or retained.
Exact WUP point query returned one polygon. Native identity was unikalus_nr=440010524440; geometry was returned unchanged in GeoJSON coordinates with outSR=4326.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Source layer LKS-94 / EPSG:3346; bounded response requested as WGS 84 / EPSG:4326.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: unikalus_nr (alias Unikalus Nr.); OBJECTID and GlobalID were observed but not used as the canonical sample identity.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: one exact point, intersects, outFields=OBJECTID,unikalus_nr,GlobalID, returnGeometry=true

qualification.reason: Public parcel service and one safe bounded sample are evidenced; adapter qualification remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
One point hit demonstrates service reachability and a parcel response, not citywide completeness or temporal currency.

The Kaunas service is a local municipal map service using Registrų centras parcel data; national geoportal and Registrų centras pages were treated as general/national agency context unless they exposed the local layer.
Only one polygon is retained; raw response evidence remains under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.
uncertainty: Parcel service reachability and schema are verified anonymously for the exact point. Coverage, update cadence, licensing beyond the public service metadata, and adapter/runtime behavior remain for serial review.
